description:
Add the git module's query for the repository's configured `user.name`.

## Background

- The claim-release actor fallback reads `user.name` with its own `git -C <worktree> config user.name` (`crates/jit/src/commands/claim.rs:308`), the last git spawn in the claim commands once their branch lookup goes through the module.
- `git config user.name` prints the value and exits 1 when it is unset.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `GitCheckout::user_name()` reads `user.name` with one git process and returns `None` when it is unset.
- [hard] REQ-02: The behaviour suite covers a set and an unset name and counts one process per query.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: User name query in the git module
